question: How is variety considered if this is not really variegated?
premises: Śivas light comes, yet variegated is this only unreally.
Therein, from entry into the not-that-form, variety is considered.
inference: Variety is apparent only, and its consideration starts from not-that-form entry.
plain_english: Śivas light comes. Variegated is this, not in reality — therein, from entry into the not-that-form, variety is considered.
